title: AGRICULTURAL AND FOOD RISK MANAGEMENT
description: Examines the economics of uncertainty and risk and how decision making within agricultural and food sectors is affected by them. Topics include economic analysis of risk, management of agricultural production risk with insurance, commodity price risk management using futures and options, and how agribusiness managers can manage strategic risk.
